positions.title: Software Engineering (DevOps) Intern
positions.description:

- Maintaining automated CI/CD pipelines for deployment and testing to promote the uniformity and reliability of company’s software applications

- Testing new software releases to ensure stability

Technologies Used:
- Jenkins
- Git/Github
- AWS (Lambda, S3,  ES2, Cloudformation)
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- Languages: Python, Shell, Javascript, Typescript 
- Mac, Ubuntu

projects.title: Facial Recognition Program
projects.description:
Collaborated with 4 fellow computer science students to produce this basic facial recognition application for the final project of Notre Dame's data structures course. The program consists of a GUI which allows the user to upload images, which are subsequently processed by Microsoft's Face API. The user then selects, from a number of options, an attribute in which to sort the images. Utilizing the JSON data returned by the Face API, the program constructs a binary heap to sort the images based upon the selected parameter and returns the first image to the GUI along with its facial information.

Technologies used: C#, XAML, JSON, Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft Face API
